title: helleborine latifolia var. dunensis
intro: Helleborine latifolia var. dunensis, commonly known as the green helleborine, is a type of flowering orchid native to Europe, particularly in the UK and Ireland. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in soothing sore throats and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of green helleborine include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to flush out excess fluids from the body, and its antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
